transcript: Hey this is for Tom Henderson at 88 Elm Boulevard. Cleared a blocked kitchen drain line using the snake. Um, ended up replacing the cracked p-trap underneath. Thought I'd need two PVC p-traps, wait, scratch that, only used one p-trap in the end. Snake service is standard on the sheet. Took me three quarters of an hour total for the labor. No extra parts.

expected.job_summary: Cleared blocked kitchen drain and replaced p-trap
expected.notes: Used snake to clear main kitchen line.
